column_description: Unique identifier for each access event.
ID of the user accessing the system. may be NULL.
Date and time of the access. may be NULL.
Type of access (e.g., view, edit, delete). always exactly one of 'view', 'edit', 'delete'. may be NULL.
ID of the robot being accessed. may be NULL.
ID of the motion path being accessed. may be NULL.
Result of the access (e.g., success, failure). always exactly one of 'success', 'failure'. may be NULL.
